chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us. He said: Ya'qub ibn Yazid narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Muhammad al-Qubti. He said: al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said:

The people are heedless of what the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said regarding 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) on the day of the chamber of Umm Ibrahim, just as they were heedless of what he said regarding him on the Day of Ghadir Khumm. Indeed, the Messenger of God was in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim, and his companions were with him, when 'Ali came, but they did not make way for him. When he saw that they were not making way, he said: "O people! These are my Ahl al-Bayt. You trivialize them while I am alive among you. By God, if I am absent from you, God will not be absent from you. Serenity, solace, happiness, and glad tidings are for whoever follows 'Ali, aligns with him, and submits to him and to the deputies from his descendants. It is my responsibility to admit them into my intercession, for they are my followers, and whoever follows me is of me. This is a tradition that passed through me from Ibrahim (peace be upon him), because I am from Ibrahim and Ibrahim is from me, and my virtue is his virtue and his virtue is my virtue, and I am more virtuous than him.
The confirmation of that is the saying of my Lord: "Offspring, one of the other, and God is Hearing, Knowing."
And the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) had injured his leg in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim, so that the people came to visit him.

key_terms.أهل بيتي: Ahl Bayti - My household/family; referring to the Prophet's purified family
key_terms.الأوصياء: al-Awsiya - The deputies/successors from Ali's descendants, referring to the divinely appointed Imams
key_terms.شفاعة: Shafa'a - Intercession; the Prophet's ability to intercede on behalf of believers on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.غدير خم: Ghadir Khumm - the historic pond where the Prophet declared Ali's authority on 18 Dhu al-Hijja 10 AH
key_terms.مشربة: Mashrabah - an upper chamber or roofed sitting area; here referring to a specific location associated with Mariya al-Qibtiyya (Umm Ibrahim), the Prophet's wife

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about Ali and Ahl al-Bayt in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that the Prophet (SAWW) defended the status of Imam Ali (AS) and Ahl al-Bayt when companions failed to show them respect in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim. The Prophet warned that God is ever-watchful, promised intercession for followers of Ali and his successors, and invoked the Abrahamic prophetic lineage as confirmed by Quran 3:34. This incident occurred when the Prophet was recovering from a leg injury.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us. He said: Ya`qub b. Yazid narrated to us from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Muhammad al-Qubti. He said: al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:

The people are heedless of what the Messenger of Allah (s) said regarding `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim, just as they are heedless of what he said regarding him on the Day of Ghadir Khumm. The Messenger of Allah (s) was in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim, and his companions were with him, when `Ali (as) came. They did not make way for him. When he saw that they did not make way for him, he said: “O people! These are my Ahl al-Bayt. You trivialize them whilst I am alive and whilst I am among you. Surely, by Allah, when I am away from you, Allah will certainly not be absent from you. Surely, serenity, solace, happiness, and glad tidings are for those who follow `Ali, align with him, and are at peace with him and the deputies from his descendants. It will be my responsibility to bring them into my intercession, for they are my followers, and whoever follows me is surely of me. This is a tradition that has passed through Ibrahim (as), for I am from Ibrahim and Ibrahim is from me. My virtue is his virtue, and his virtue is my virtue – and I am more virtuous than him.
The saying of my Lord confirms that, ‘Offspring, one of the other, and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.’ [3:34]”
The Messenger of Allah (s) had injured his leg in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim when the people had come to him.
